gallery.description: The Museum of the People's Liberation Army (Rabouni camp, 20 km south of Tindouf, Algeria), set up by Sahrawi Arab Democratic Republic (SADR) government (Polisario Front)(*), show the warfare seized to the Moroccan army during the wartime (1976-1991). This exhibit also shows some documents on the first actions carried out by the Polisario Front since 1973 initially against Spanish colonization and, later, against Moroccan army. (*) The SADR, proclaimed on February 27, 1976 by the Polisario Front, is not recognized internationally.
